name: What due diligence is required when buying a luxury investment property?

mainEntity.name: What due diligence is required when buying a luxury investment property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Due diligence for luxury properties is extensive, involving detailed financial analysis, property inspections (including structural, mechanical, and specialized systems), title searches, and review of HOA documents. It's crucial to understand zoning laws and potential environmental considerations, especially for waterfront properties. Engaging expert legal and inspection services is paramount. Kelby Contreras guides clients through a comprehensive due diligence checklist, ensuring all aspects, from flood zone compliance to permit history, are thoroughly reviewed for properties in coastal areas like Hollywood Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Extensive due diligence includes financial analysis, detailed property inspections, title searches, and HOA document review.
